svg.title: Measurement apparatus and analysis chain
svg.desc: The collection harness drives each cell, per-cell gates and storage record the outcome, the suite ledger determines what is analysed, and offline analysis produces the reported tables and the archive.
svg.text: 20 cells, order shuffled within each factor group from a seed
per cell: reset, settle 75 s, purge, reconfigure, purge again
collect 30 s, drain to quiescence, snapshot, verify
settle and drain are constant, so neither varies with the factor
records which cells passed, and under which run identifier
a failed attempt leaves its files on disk after its rows are purged
so the analysis reads the ledger rather than the directory
no metric is computed during collection
detections joined to ground truth within a cell, on both identifiers
a defect in a metric is corrected without recollecting anything
